verses.english: An asker asked for a punishment sure to befall
—which none can avert from the faithless —
from Allah, Lord of the lofty stations.

verses.arabic: تَعْرُجُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَٱلرُّوحُ إِلَيْهِ فِى يَوْمٍۢ كَانَ مِقْدَارُهُۥ خَمْسِينَ أَلْفَ سَنَةٍۢ
verses.english: The angels and the Spirit ascend to Him in a day whose span is fifty thousand years.
verses.transliteration_html: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin
verses.transliteration_text: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin

verses.english: So be patient, with a patience that is graceful.
Indeed they see it to be far off,
and We see it to be near.
The day when the sky will be like molten copper,
and the mountains like [tufts of] dyed wool,
and no friend will inquire about [the welfare of his] friend,

verses.arabic: يُبَصَّرُونَهُمْ ۚ يَوَدُّ ٱلْمُجْرِمُ لَوْ يَفْتَدِى مِنْ عَذَابِ يَوْمِئِذٍۭ بِبَنِيهِ
verses.english: [though] they will be placed within each other’s sight. The guilty one will wish he could ransom himself from the punishment of that day at the price of his children,
verses.transliteration_html: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi
verses.transliteration_text: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi

verses.english: his spouse and his brother,
his kin, which had sheltered him

verses.arabic: وَمَن فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ جَمِيعًۭا ثُمَّ يُنجِيهِ
verses.english: and all those who are upon the earth, if that might deliver him.
verses.transliteration_html: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi
verses.transliteration_text: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi

verses.english: Never! Indeed, it is a blazing fire,
which strips away the scalp.
It invites him, who has turned back [from the truth] and forsaken [it],
amassing [wealth] and hoarding [it].
Indeed man has been created covetous:
anxious when an ill befalls him
and grudging [charity] when good comes his way
—[all are such] except the prayerful,
those who persevere in their prayers
and there is a known share in whose wealth
for the beggar and the deprived,
and who affirm the Day of Retribution,

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ هُم مِّنْ عَذَابِ رَبِّهِم مُّشْفِقُونَ
verses.english: and those who are apprehensive of the punishment of their Lord
verses.transliteration_html: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona
verses.transliteration_text: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona

verses.english: (there is indeed no security from the punishment of their Lord)
and those who guard their private parts

verses.arabic: إِلَّا عَلَىٰٓ أَزْوَٰجِهِمْ أَوْ مَا مَلَكَتْ أَيْمَـٰنُهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ غَيْرُ مَلُومِينَ
verses.english: (apart from their spouses and their slave women, for then they are not blameworthy;
verses.transliteration_html: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena
verses.transliteration_text: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱبْتَغَىٰ وَرَآءَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْعَادُونَ
verses.english: but whoever seeks beyond that—it is they who are the transgressors)
verses.transliteration_html: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

verses.english: and those who keep their trusts and covenants,
and those who are observant of their testimonies,
and those who are watchful of their prayers.
They will be in gardens, held in honour.
What is the matter with the faithless that they scramble toward you,
from left and right, in groups?

verses.arabic: أَيَطْمَعُ كُلُّ ٱمْرِئٍۢ مِّنْهُمْ أَن يُدْخَلَ جَنَّةَ نَعِيمٍۢ
verses.english: Does each man among them hope to enter the garden of bliss?
verses.transliteration_html: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin
verses.transliteration_text: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin

verses.english: Never! Indeed, We created them from what they know.

verses.arabic: فَلَآ أُقْسِمُ بِرَبِّ ٱلْمَشَـٰرِقِ وَٱلْمَغَـٰرِبِ إِنَّا لَقَـٰدِرُونَ
verses.english: So I swear by the Lord of the easts and the wests that We are able
verses.transliteration_html: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona
verses.transliteration_text: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona

verses.arabic: عَلَىٰٓ أَن نُّبَدِّلَ خَيْرًۭا مِّنْهُمْ وَمَا نَحْنُ بِمَسْبُوقِينَ
verses.english: to replace them with [others] better than them and We are not to be outmaneuvered.
verses.transliteration_html: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena
verses.transliteration_text: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

verses.arabic: فَذَرْهُمْ يَخُوضُوا۟ وَيَلْعَبُوا۟ حَتَّىٰ يُلَـٰقُوا۟ يَوْمَهُمُ ٱلَّذِى يُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: So leave them to gossip and play till they encounter the day they are promised:
verses.transliteration_html: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يَخْرُجُونَ مِنَ ٱلْأَجْدَاثِ سِرَاعًۭا كَأَنَّهُمْ إِلَىٰ نُصُبٍۢ يُوفِضُونَ
verses.english: the day when they emerge from graves, hastening, as if racing toward a target,
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona

verses.arabic: خَـٰشِعَةً أَبْصَـٰرُهُمْ تَرْهَقُهُمْ ذِلَّةٌۭ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمُ ٱلَّذِى كَانُوا۟ يُوعَدُونَ
verses.english: with a humbled look [in their eyes], overcast by abasement. That is the day they had been promised.
verses.transliteration_html: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona
verses.transliteration_text: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona
